parsed.explanation: The write-up derives all finiteness (the sets B_1..B_s, hence L) solely from the set-theoretic lemma that a pairwise-intersecting family of finite sets has a finite generating list of transversals. That lemma is false, and the objection's witness works: with F_k={x_0,...,x_k,y_k}, T_n={y_0,...,y_{n-1},x_n} meets every F_k (y_k for k<n, x_n for k>=n) and is inclusion-minimal, giving infinitely many minimal transversals, impossible for a finitely generated up-set. Its 'proof' also silently asserts C is a member of every derived family. No arithmetic large-prime-erasure argument (bounding relevant primes by a_1 or a_1^2) appears anywhere else, so L6.2 is unestablished; repairing requires a new lemma.
